It is broader than murder: all murders are culpable homicide, but not all culpable homicide rises to the level of murder. Think of it as the...

It is the genus of which murder is the species, and is either 'culpable homi...
  Covers: Intentionally causing the death of a person by a direct act such as stabbing, poisoning, or strik... | Causing death by an act done with knowledge that it is likely to cause death, even if death was n... | Causing death by an act done with the intention of causing bodily injury that is likely to result...
  Excludes: Death caused purely by accident or misfortune without any criminal intention or knowledge — such... | Acts of private defence where death is caused within the lawful limits of the right of private de...
